purpose: Reusable technology-integration axes with accepted TL2 information-control, Power/Reactor, and Shield working candidates plus separately factored Armor Protection/Integrity sensitivity for sequential TL design.

pairingPolicy.note: Candidate/control variants should share random streams whenever the changed dimension permits a clean paired comparison.

activationPolicy: Activate only the smallest dependency-relevant submatrix needed to answer the checkpoint question.
Include mixed-TL and high-power-demand contexts whenever a new component can change power, reach, EW, targeting, or defense opportunity cost.
Use actual-consumer preflight plus one-trial full-pipeline smoke before substantive Monte Carlo for any new or materially changed integrated study.

Audit dispatch, pre-run validation, all shared/global release-gate classifications, study-family whitelists, study-specific gates, report routing, schema/baseline bindings, and checkpoint stage definitions before handoff.
Keep outcome/balance targets review-only unless the checkpoint explicitly promotes a deterministic invariant; never make one-trial smoke depend on statistical outcomes.

When Power/Reactor is the changed dependency, pair reactor candidates at identical combat, information-control, and doctrine settings; treat power output, efficiency, condition mapping, overload, and Space as separate axes unless the checkpoint explicitly changes more than one.

When Shield progression is the changed dependency, vary capacity, recharge, hardening, condition behavior, power maintenance, and Installation Space as separate axes unless the checkpoint explicitly combines them.

When Armor progression is the changed dependency, vary Armor Protection and Armor Integrity separately; preserve the current weapon APEN values so protection counterplay is measured rather than hidden by simultaneous weapon changes.

currentCoverage.currentExpansion: Armor AP and AI are now separately factored. CP85 crosses AP0/1 x AI4/5 with Shield 2/3 across two information-control environments, six Kinetic/Energy-vs-Kinetic/Energy/Missile family pairings, and three geometry/order contexts while holding Side-A Reactor 6.
currentCoverage.nextExpansion: After CP85 review, promote only the armor property/package supported by evidence. Do not assume AP and AI mature together; choose the next progression dimension only after checking layered-defense and weapon-family consequences.
